Name: Budgie Companion (Parrot Trinket Reskin)
Author: Caydebug
Description:
Uses Content Patcher to replace the Parrot Egg companion with a budgie.

[u][b]Currently available colors:[/b][/u][list]
[*]Male light green normal (Wild)
[*]Female light green normal (WildF)
[*]Male cobalt dilute (BlizzardM)
[*]Female cobalt dilute (Blizzard)
[*]White ino (Albino)
[*]Yellow ino (Lutino)
[/list]This mod uses the Wild color morph by default. If you would like to change your budgie's morph, open the content.json file with a text editor and change the "FromFile" line to reference the appropriate image in the assets folder (ex: "assets/budgiecompanionblizzard.png").

If anyone has requests for color variations I'd be happy to make them - going to do some basic color morphs, but if you want it to look like your pet, feel free to send me some pictures of them (preferably with front, side, and rear angles with neutral lighting). I'll do my best to replicate them within the sprite and name it after them.

Made in memory of my pet budgie, Blizzard, who passed away yesterday (3/17/26).
